# Schema `core`

The organisation, sites, locations, users, roles, sessions, settings and the licence.

## `core.licences`

Licence files installed by an administrator, newest first; the newest one that verifies is in force. Rows are never changed or deleted: a renewal is a new row.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `licence_text` | text | no |  |  | The signed licence file exactly as issued by NorthSpec (JSON with an Ed25519 signature). Verified offline on every read. |
| `licence_ref` | text | no |  |  | NorthSpec's reference for the licence, from the file. |
| `licensee` | text | no |  |  | Customer the licence was issued to, from the file. |
| `issued_on` | date | no |  |  | Date the licence was issued, from the file. |
| `expires_on` | date | yes |  |  | Last day the licence covers, from the file; null for a perpetual licence. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `core.locations`

Places kit can be, per site: a store, a van, a yard or a job site. Items are checked out to and back in from locations. Archived, not deleted. _(row-level security)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `site_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.sites` | Site the row belongs to (row-level security key, DB-06). |
| `parent_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.locations` | Parent location in the same site (a cage inside a store); null at the top of the tree. |
| `kind` | text | no |  |  | site (a job site or customer premises), van, store or yard. |
| `code` | text | no |  |  | Location code, unique within the site; printed on labels (e.g. VAN-03). |
| `name` | text | no |  |  | Location name as staff know it (e.g. Van 3, Main store). |
| `reference` | text | yes |  |  | A vehicle registration, job number or similar, as entered. A registration is not a personal record here: it names the van. |
| `notes` | text | yes |  |  | Free-text notes about the location. |
| `path` | ltree | no |  |  | Materialised path of ids from the top of the tree to this location (ltree). Maintained by trigger; query subtrees with path <@ parent_path. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |
| `archived_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When the row was archived (UTC). Master data is archived, never deleted (DB-04). Null means current. |
| `assigned_user_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | [personal] For a van: the person who drives or looks after it, so "to my van" means this van. An Operative may check kit out to themselves and to their own van only. Null for other locations. |
| `last_counted_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When a stocktake of this location was last closed (UTC); null if never counted. Locations not counted for longer than the recount setting need action. |

## `core.organisations`

The customer running this install: exactly one row, made at first-run set-up. Shown in the header in place of the product name.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `singleton` | boolean | no | `true` |  | Always true and unique, so the table can hold only one row. |
| `name` | text | no |  |  | Organisation name shown in the app header. |
| `country_code` | character(2) | no | `'GB'::bpchar` |  | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; the default for new sites. |
| `default_time_zone` | text | no | `'Europe/London'::text` |  | IANA time zone offered first for new sites (e.g. Europe/London). |
| `trusted_proxies` | cidr[] | no | `'{}'::cidr[]` |  | Addresses (or ranges) of the customer's own reverse proxy, named by an administrator. Empty (default): the connecting address is used for rate limits and X-Forwarded-For is ignored. Only a request arriving from one of these has its forwarded client address believed. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |

| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `core.roles`

Named sets of on/off permissions (area x View/Create/Edit/Approve) with a site scope. Organisation-wide. Seeded roles are editable defaults, except the locked Administrator.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `code` | text | no |  |  | Role code used in code and tests, unique. |
| `name` | text | no |  |  | Role name shown to admins, unique among live roles ignoring case. |
| `description` | text | yes |  |  | What the role is for. |
| `permissions` | text[] | no | `'{}'::text[]` |  | Permission codes granted, area.action (e.g. items.edit). Must be in core.permission_codes(). Ignored for the full-access Administrator role. |
| `full_access` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True only for the locked Administrator role: every permission at every site, whatever else the row says. It can't be edited or archived. |
| `site_scope` | text | no | `'all'::text` |  | all: the role works at every site the user is assigned; listed: only the sites in role_sites. |
| `requires_mfa` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True if holders must turn on two-factor sign-in before they can do anything else. Always true for the Administrator. |
| `is_system` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True for the roles shipped with the product. They can be edited, except the Administrator, but not archived. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |
| `archived_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When the row was archived (UTC). Master data is archived, never deleted (DB-04). Null means current. |

## `core.sessions`

Signed-in browser sessions. The cookie holds a random token; only its SHA-256 hash is stored. Old rows are deleted by the worker.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `user_id` | uuid | no |  | `core.users` | User signed in. |
| `token_hash` | bytea | no |  |  | SHA-256 of the session token in the cookie. The token itself is never stored. |
| `mfa_pending` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True after a correct password while the two-factor code is still owed; such a session grants nothing else. |
| `last_seen_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | Last request on this session; the session ends after NORTHKIT_SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES without one. |
| `expires_at` | timestamp with time zone | no |  |  | Absolute end of the session (NORTHKIT_SESSION_ABSOLUTE_HOURS after sign-in). |
| `revoked_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When the session was ended by sign-out or an admin; null while live. |
| `ip_address` | inet | yes |  |  | [personal] IP address at sign-in. |
| `user_agent` | text | yes |  |  | [personal] Browser user agent at sign-in, cut to 500 characters. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |

## `core.sites`

Depots, branches and yards the organisation runs kit from. The isolation root: row-level security on id, so a user only sees sites in their scope. Archived, not deleted. _(row-level security)_

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `code` | text | no |  |  | Short site reference shown on screens and labels, unique across the install. Upper-case letters, digits, _ and -. |
| `name` | text | no |  |  | Site name as staff know it. |
| `address_line_1` | text | yes |  |  | First line of the site address. |
| `address_line_2` | text | yes |  |  | Second line of the site address. |
| `town` | text | yes |  |  | Town or city. |
| `postcode` | text | yes |  |  | Postcode, stored as entered. |
| `country_code` | character(2) | no | `'GB'::bpchar` |  | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. |
| `time_zone` | text | no | `'Europe/London'::text` |  | IANA time zone (e.g. Europe/London). Times are stored in UTC; due dates and reminders are worked out in this zone. |
| `phone` | text | yes |  |  | Main site phone number (a business number, not a person). |
| `email` | text | yes |  |  | Main site email address (a shared mailbox, not a person). |
| `manager_user_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who manages the site; null if not set. |
| `notes` | text | yes |  |  | Free-text notes about the site (access, gate codes held elsewhere, key holders). No personal health details. |

| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |

| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |
| `archived_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When the row was archived (UTC). Master data is archived, never deleted (DB-04). Null means current. |

## `core.users`

People who sign in: office staff, kit managers, supervisors, operatives. Organisation-level (not owned by one site); which sites a user can see comes from all_sites, user_sites and their roles. Archived, not deleted.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no | `uuid_v7()` |  | Primary key, a UUIDv7 (time-ordered). |
| `email` | text | no |  |  | [personal] Sign-in email address, unique ignoring case. |
| `display_name` | text | no |  |  | [personal] Name shown on screens and in the audit trail. |
| `phone` | text | yes |  |  | [personal] Contact phone number, as entered. |
| `password_hash` | text | yes |  |  | Argon2id hash in PHC format. Null means the account cannot sign in with a password. Never logged or audited. |
| `must_change_password` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True when an admin set the password; the user must choose a new one at next sign-in. |
| `mfa_secret_encrypted` | text | yes |  |  | TOTP secret, AES-256-GCM encrypted with NORTHKIT_SECRET_KEY. Never logged or audited. |
| `mfa_enabled_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When two-factor sign-in was turned on; null means off. |
| `mfa_last_used_step` | bigint | yes |  |  | Last TOTP time step accepted, so the same code cannot be used twice. |
| `failed_login_count` | integer | no | `0` |  | Failed sign-ins since the last success or lockout. Five in a row locks the account. |
| `locked_until` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | Sign-in is refused until this time (15 minutes after the fifth failure); null when not locked. |
| `last_login_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | Last successful sign-in (UTC). |
| `all_sites` | boolean | no | `false` |  | True if the user works at every site (organisation-wide staff); otherwise user_sites lists them. Narrowed further by the site scope of their roles. |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row was created (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `created_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who created the row; null for system jobs and migrations. Set by trigger. |
| `updated_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the row last changed (UTC). Set by trigger. |
| `updated_by` | uuid | yes |  | `core.users` | User who last changed the row; null for system jobs. Set by trigger. |
| `row_version` | integer | no | `1` |  | Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every update. Office edits send it back for optimistic locking. |
| `archived_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  | When the row was archived (UTC). Master data is archived, never deleted (DB-04). Null means current. |
| `home_site_id` | uuid | yes |  | `core.sites` | Site the site filter opens on when the browser has no choice remembered; null opens on all the user's sites. Ignored if the user no longer works there. Set by the user in Account settings (audited). |
